summary: Validated 4-phase Torado migration. 18/19 backend pytest cases pass (1 skipped: /api/finance/ap-ledger endpoint not implemented). All migrated data is reachable via correct endpoints. Frontend dashboards render with real data on all migrated routes except /master/items (frontend route missing).

minor.issue: Endpoint not implemented (404). Data exists in 'ap_ledger' collection (832 docs) and ap_invoices mirror (348). UI/API consumers cannot list AP ledger entries directly. Recommend adding GET /api/finance/ap-ledger -> list with vendor names + amounts.
Returns 404. Canonical path is /api/finance/journals. Update review-request docs or add an alias.
Returns 404. Actual mount is /api/inventory/items/pricing/list (router prefix /api/inventory/items). Consider adding /api/finance/item-pricing alias for consistency with Finance module.
Returns 404. Actual path is /api/master/chart-of-accounts (166 entries verified).
?limit=N query parameter ignored — server enforces per_page=20. Use page/per_page params. meta.total reports correct counts (52 vendors, 1792 items).

ui_bugs.issue: /master/items renders 404 'Halaman tidak ditemukan'. Likely route mounted under /admin/master/items per sidebar. Either fix route or add redirect.

integration_issues.issue: Page renders but two 503 responses observed in console (some workboard sub-call failing intermittently). Workboard list cards still appear.

passed_tests: Auth: login admin@torado.id returns valid JWT (data.access_token, user.email, default_portal=admin)
Item pricing list: rows returned (Phase 2 multi-period verified)
AP aging: rows + buckets present, grand_total = Rp 1,280,244,146.10 (>1 Miliar)
Cash position: net_liquid_cash = Rp 3,361,165,511 (bank=9 accts, petty_cash=1 acct)
Executive sales-trend?days=30: 30 daily points with non-zero totals (avg Rp 35.7M)
Executive brand-mix: 5 brands ALT/DLS/CAL/RKP/BKK with share_pct (period 2026-05)
AI generate-journal-entry: 200 OK (Gemini integration via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY working)
Frontend login flow → /portal-select with 8 portal cards
action_items: Add GET /api/finance/ap-ledger endpoint (or document the canonical AP ledger list endpoint)
Fix frontend route /master/items (404). Either add route or update navigation links to /admin/master/items.
Optional: add aliases /api/finance/journal-entries, /api/finance/item-pricing, /api/finance/chart-of-accounts so paths match docs/UI expectations
Master list endpoints respect ?limit – currently capped at per_page=20
critical_code_review_comments: Migrated data is intact and accessible; total counts match user's targets (vendors=52, items=1792, CoA=166, AP grand_total=1.28B IDR, Cash=3.36B IDR, sales_mtd=184M IDR).
Response envelope {success,data,errors,meta} is consistent across endpoints — good. But AP-ledger missing endpoint creates a UX gap.
Frontend /master/items 404 is a regression risk; route table should be audited.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend response envelope is {success, data, errors, meta}. Use unwrap helper. Master list endpoints cap per_page=20 but meta.total has the real count. Phase-1 PR endpoint = /api/finance/payment-requests. Phase-2 item pricing = /api/inventory/items/pricing/list (NOT /api/finance/item-pricing). Journals = /api/finance/journals. CoA = /api/master/chart-of-accounts. AP-ledger has NO list endpoint — only ap-aging aggregates and per-vendor rows.
